current_endpoint_contracts.basis: Owner-authorized 1 A sustained negative-12-volt pass-through design basis, 2026-10-17: actual J3 pin 14 to J_SIG1 pin 1. The existing 125 percent conductor geometry margin applies once to the complete path. C22, C23 and R75 are local bypass/divider leaves, not alternate full-current sinks or a basis for reducing the pass-through load. This is not a measured load, PSU source guarantee, connector/barrel capacity, inrush, thermal or release qualification.

Current hierarchical 02-power-usb schematic and saved-board native pins: USB-C VBUS bank to F1 input. Uses only the pre-existing 0.75 A service-chain conductor basis and its once-applied 125 percent geometry margin; no fuse clamp, equal pin sharing, barrel, inrush, thermal or release qualification is inferred.

Current hierarchical 02-power-usb schematic and saved-board native pins: F1 output to FB1 input. The existing service-chain current and margin are unchanged; component hold/trip/current ratings are not substituted for a load or fault-current bound.

Current hierarchical 02-power-usb schematic and saved-board native pins: FB1 output to U6 IN2 (pin 2), with existing C9/C52/C53 bypass leaves. The unchanged 0.75 A conductor basis applies to the aggregate path, not separately to each capacitor or USB-C pin. No mux clamp, inrush, barrel or release qualification follows.

supply_consumer_allocations.basis: Full unchanged 3 A SYS output conductor design basis plus TPS2121 enabled-input quiescent maximum 0.0004 A (TI SLVSEA3F section 7.5). The independent native receiver requires a selected RUX package, one distinct common OUT net carrying that existing authority, one physical shared-rail tap and unchanged aggregate source/sink partitions. The 20 A main cable-rail ceiling is unchanged; the existing 125 percent geometry margin is applied once. No equal branch sharing, source clamp, input-capacitor inrush, fault, terminal/barrel capacity or release qualification follows.

Existing 0.5 A local conductor allowance within the unchanged 3 A shared SYS rail design basis. Applies only to the exclusive single TJA1051 VCC island, including its selected local capacitors. Not a source clamp, inrush, capacitor fault or barrel qualification; the shared Hub path remains sized for the unchanged aggregate.

net_current_contract_notes: Sustained worst case: 3V3 and 5V use the owner-ratified 20 A ceiling, 12V uses two 6 A circuits, and standby uses 3 A.

The owner authorized 1 A sustained for the ATX negative-12-volt pass-through on 2026-10-17. Size the actual selected-layer copper for 1.25 A after the unchanged routing margin, without dividing current among layers or counting the divider current as the pass-through load. The conservative shared-return calculation must include this newly declared rail; it receives no assumed cancellation credit. This authorization does not itself qualify the existing geometry or selected contacts.
The interconnect cross-check is 18.32 A per ratified blade joint after 125 percent margin.

The selected F1 1206L075/16WR (C371166) USB service chain uses the platform's existing 0.75 A sustained routing design basis (docs/usb-ingress-bom-delta-2026-07-24.md, 24-pin cascade; same explicit basis as the PCIe and 12VHPWR service cells). This is a conservative geometry envelope, not a measured load, guaranteed PTC clamp, TPS2121 fault-current limit, or barrel/inrush/release qualification. The normal 125 percent geometry margin applies once. Main-rail ceilings and reviewed component budgets are unchanged.

The Hub-bound output uses the existing Hub shared 2.5 A design basis, not 2.5 A per header: J6P and legacy J2 are alternate connections to the same single reviewed Hub. +5V_SYS and 5VSB_MUX use a conservative 3 A conductor design basis: the same 2.5 A shared external allocation plus 0.5 A local allowance. The existing wireless-disabled ATX +3V3 budget (0.2048376 A with its existing 20 percent margin), TJA1051 VCC short-circuit maximum (0.110 A; NXP TJA1051 Rev 9 table 7), and two TPS2121 quiescent maxima (0.0004 A each; TI SLVSEA3F section 7.5) remain below that local allowance. This adds missing routing authority only: it does not substitute a source rating for the actual component load budget, increase the standby source ceiling, rate terminal/barrel sharing, qualify inrush, or assert that the TPS2121 clamps at 3 A. Existing 125 percent conductor sizing applies once to these design bases. The USB-only service mode remains bounded by its separate 0.75 A basis; it is not qualified for the full external Hub allocation.
